programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.subtitle: Manage the C2B programme catalogue in English and Spanish.
programmes.searchPlaceholder: Title, code or tag — press Enter
programmes.emptyText: Create a programme or change the filters.
programmes.created: Programme created. You can now upload a cover image.
programmes.deleteText: "{{title}}" will be deleted. If anyone has enrolled, it will be archived instead.
programmes.archivedInstead: The programme has enrollments, so it was archived instead.

hints.departments: Leave empty for all departments (e.g. ICT, Finance, HR).
hints.skills: These skills are used by the AI to match learners.
hints.additional: Custom fields defined by C2B admins.
hints.cover: Shown on the catalogue and programme page. Without one, a category image is used.
hints.coverAfterCreate: You can upload a cover image after creating the programme.

errors.titleRequired: Enter a title in at least one language.

programmeForm.noCustomFields: No custom fields yet. Create them in Programme fields.

fields.title: Programme fields
fields.subtitle: Add your own fields to every programme without code changes. They appear on the programme form and, if visible, on programme pages.
fields.loadError: We couldn't load the programme fields.
fields.emptyText: Create a field such as "Certification body" to capture extra programme details.
fields.reorderHint: Drag the handle (or focus it and use Space + arrow keys) to change the order.
fields.deactivateText: "{{label}}" will disappear from forms and pages. Values already saved on programmes are kept.
fields.previewHint: This is how the field will look on the programme form.

form.label: Label
form.keyHint: Generated from the English label. Cannot be changed later.
form.requiredHint: Programmes cannot be saved without a value.
form.showToLearnersHint: Display on the public and learner programme pages.
form.useInAIHint: Send this value to the AI when matching programmes.

errors.key: Start with a lowercase letter; use 2–50 letters, numbers or _.
errors.label: Enter a label in at least one language.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.subtitle: Review registrations and manage partner organizations.
orgs.searchPlaceholder: Name, industry or country — press Enter
orgs.emptyText: Organizations appear here as they register.
orgs.approveText: {{name}} will get a default invite link and can start inviting employees.
orgs.rejectText: The organization admin will see your reason and can edit and resubmit.
orgs.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Please add a contact person and your departments.
orgs.suspendText: Invite links stop working for {{name}}. Employees can still log in.
orgs.deleteText_one: {{name}} and its invite links will be permanently deleted. Its {{count}} employee keeps their account as an individual learner.
orgs.deleteText_other: {{name}} and its invite links will be permanently deleted. Its {{count}} employees keep their accounts as individual learners.
orgs.deleteDone_one: {{name}} was deleted. {{count}} employee is now an individual learner.
orgs.deleteDone_other: {{name}} was deleted. {{count}} employees are now individual learners.

editor.newText: Register an organization on behalf of a client. It is approved straight away.
editor.editText: Changes are visible to the organization admin right away.
editor.ownerText: The person who will manage this organization. Share the temporary password securely.
